text:
Amy L.: Hey team — quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A about keys, VPCs, and audit logs. A few things folks asked for: 1) KMS rotation policy & BYOQ timeline, 2) exporting audit logs for SOC2 evidence (retention + S3 export), 3) what to expect for Private/VPC control-plane latency and access. Can security/infra clarify?

Jordan (security): Good summary — thanks Amy. Short answers: 1) KMS rotations: we rotate service keys quarterly by default; customers using BYOK/BYOQ can choose auto-rotate or manual, we expect GA BYOQ support for on-prem HSMs in our October release (internal roadmap name: q4-hsm). 2) Audit logs: default retention is 90 days in-hosted, with export hooks to customer S3 (we had a question about longer retention for SOC2 — we can support 1yr+ via archive exports). 3) Private/VPC: control plane calls are proxied over private link; typical p99 control-plane latency is ~120ms across regions, payload-dependent.

Chris I.: For clarity — the S3 export is a push job that runs daily, can also be triggered on-demand via the console. We support delivery to a customer-owned bucket with an IAM role we assume. Example policy (minimal) is:```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:PutObject","s3:ListBucket"],"Resource":["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-audit-exports/*"]}
  ]
}
```

Marco P.: To add — audit entries include request metadata, model id, route, and truncated payloads for size. We do not include full customer-provided prompts in exported logs unless the customer opts into full-log export (opt-in because of PII/security). Also adding retention note: exports are gzipped daily, and lifecycle rules in the customer's bucket can transition to Glacier/DeepArchive.

Lea: Quick compliance Q — for SOC2 evidence, will the exported logs contain the required user access audit trails (who accessed what and when)? Jordan, Tara — can you confirm?

Tara (compliance): Yes — exports include IAM principal, timestamp, action, and resource. For Dedicated and Private customers we can also include signed audit bundles with HMAC so you can verify integrity. We'll provide a checklist for auditors.

Amy L.: Awesome. Two small product asks from the PM side: 1) can we expose a small admin UI to configure export TTL and rotation cadence per-tenant, 2) wants a single-page summary for sales with simple language about BYOQ and KMS options.

Jordan (security): Product note accepted — admin UI for export TTL is in the backlog (prio: medium), but we can provide a CLI + API today. BYOQ docs will clearly state difference between BYOK (customer-managed keys in cloud KMS) and BYOQ (customer HSM).

DevOps Bot: Reminder: Security office hours scheduled — "Security Office Hours: KMS & Audit Logs" on 1965110000. RSVP at https://calendar.redwood.company/officehours-security — (reacted with :bell:).

Chris I.: On VPC expectations — for Private customers we publish a perf guide with expected latencies, peering config, and failover behavior. There are also known limitations: cross-region control-plane calls may have higher tail latencies; data plane inference traffic remains local.

Marco P.: One operational caveat — if you opt into full-log export, be mindful of token limits for payload capture; we truncate after 8k per request by default to avoid accidental exfil of enormous prompts.

Amy L.: Great—can someone paste the short office-hours agenda and the doc links here after the thread? I'll ping sales and solutions for the one-pager.

Jordan (security): Will do. Actions: 1) Jordan/Tara to produce SOC2 export checklist by end of week, 2) Chris to add S3 export example + IAM snippet to docs, 3) Marco to publish note on full-log opt-in truncation and retention. Office hours agenda + links: https://docs.redwood.company/security/kms-byooq, https://docs.redwood.company/security/audit-exports.

Tara (compliance): Also adding: auditors typically ask for key rotation proof and export integrity attestation — we'll prepare a template.

Amy L.: Thanks everyone. If there are specific customers asking for >1yr retention or HSM attestation, please loop Tara. I'll close the circle with PMs and Sales. :thumbsup:

Chris I.: ack — will update the docs and drop a note in #support when done. :white_check_mark:
